Topics · One God, one message

Why trust God after harm done in His name?

A wrong done in God's name. The Quran says His word comes in a people's own tongue, and all are honoured.

Part 1 of 4

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills[649] and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

Translator's notes

[649] i.e., those who refuse His guidance.

Quran · Ibrahim 14:4

Say it plainly: what was done to you and to your parents was a wrong, and it was done in God's name. This Step will not ask you to argue otherwise. This passage says how God's word comes: every messenger was sent in the tongue of his own people so that he could make things clear to them. Clearness in your own language is the pattern. Silencing it is not.

A question for you

What do you most want back?

If you sayMy language.
ThenThen the next passage is about languages in particular.
If you sayMy family's names for things.
ThenThose names are part of the language the next passage speaks about.
If you sayAn apology, from someone.
ThenThat is a fair thing to want, and you have every right to ask for it. This Step cannot give it to you.

Part 2 of 4

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:22

Translation

Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

Original · Hebrew

הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

Job · 31:15

World English Bible

The Quran does not treat the world's many languages as a problem to be fixed. It lists them among the signs of God, in the same sentence as the heavens and the earth, beside the many colours of people. A language is not an obstacle to hearing. It is one of the places where meaning lives. Each one carries a way of seeing that exists nowhere else.

A question for you

Which carries more of who you are: the language, the land, or the people?

If you sayThe language.
ThenThe verse makes the difference of tongues a sign. Your language is not secondary.
If you sayThe land.
ThenLand and language are bound together, and the verse sets them side by side: heavens, earth and tongues.
If you sayThe people.
ThenThe language and the land live through them. The next passage speaks of people who were made weak.

Part 3 of 4

﴿وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:5

Translation

I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

Original · Hebrew

יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃

the Psalms · 140:12

World English Bible

Now to what the Quran says God wants for people who have been pushed down. This passage says: We wish to show favour to those made weak in the land, to make them leaders, and to make them inheritors. It is spoken within one story. It shows what the Quran says about God's intention for people who were made weak: to raise them, not to leave them low.

A question for you

Who kept your language alive?

If you sayA grandparent.
ThenThat is like what the verse pictures: a weakness imposed, and a survival in spite of it.
If you sayA teacher or an elder.
ThenYou owe them much, and the verse lifts up those who stood in the shadow.
If you sayI am trying to learn it now.
ThenThat beginning fits the verse's word: inheritors.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:70

Translation

what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him? For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor. You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

Original · Hebrew

מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃ וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃ תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃

the Psalms · 8:4-6

World English Bible

Last, the plainest line: We have honoured the children of Adam. The word is for every person, with no condition. It does not say 'those who spoke the right language' or 'those who sat in the right school'. Your dignity was not given by the school and could not be taken by it. It was given before, to everyone, and it is yours now.

A question for you

What would it mean to hold your dignity as older than the harm?

If you sayTo start from where the harm could not reach.
ThenThat is exactly what the verse says: a dignity prior to anything earned.
If you sayTo pass it on to my children.
ThenThen it becomes a new line, one that begins from honour and not from the wound.
If you sayI do not know yet.
ThenThere is no need to know yet. The verse is steady, and it can wait.

The same in the other books

World English Bible

Which word of your language do you want to hear spoken today?
